comment: Real match captures. Timing selects a moment, not a promised game phase. The output records the observed round, role, map, weapon, and camera. Inspect the images for quality.
pad_routes_comment: Free-for-all lives start on the Pistol, so a weapon state walks to its pad first, then straight to the nearest pad of that gun. A route keyed by map id and gun is a list of feet waypoints walked in straight lines, or a list of {near, points} alternatives: the one whose near [x, z] is closest to the fighter's feet is walked. Map 1 is Larak Lot. The Rail sits on the Low Ramp landing under the lid, entered from the Lane's west mouth or across the Pit, so each spawn quarter has its own way down. The routes were checked from all twelve spawn slots against the server's collision and movement step.

states.name: boot_menu
states.note: Retro menu, keyboard focus, legibility, and unclipped options.

states.name: spectator_eyes
states.note: Default spectator view follows the fighter's eyes and weapon.

states.name: arena_overview
states.note: Server geometry, traversable lanes, steps, cover, and lighting.

states.name: combat_follow
states.note: README still: chase view with readable fighter silhouettes, taken once no card, centre call or caption covers the fight and two live fighters stand within 30 m in view.

states.name: body_human
states.note: Close eye-level still of a fighter the server says is human: free bone, leather and rust, face and hair, feet on the floor at hit-volume height.

states.name: body_synthetic
states.note: The same framing on a fighter in a synthetic body: bone shell, gunmetal frame, ember scarf, cyan lenses. Never Union black and red.

states.name: hud_first_person
states.note: Actual human join, saved callsign, the free-for-all Pistol start, and aim visibility. The profile asks for the synthetic body; first-person hands stay the shared gloved viewmodels.

states.name: hud_legend_pad
states.note: The joined player's first-run legend after a left trigger pull: pad names from live bindings. Letter layout forced, no pad attached.

states.name: hud_legend_keyboard
states.note: The same legend after a key press: keyboard names from live bindings.

states.name: shot_effects
states.note: Twelve frames starting at an acknowledged Pistol shot, the gun every free-for-all life starts with. Inspect flash registration, recoil, and recovery.

states.name: scatter_viewmodel
states.note: The Shotgun taken from its free-for-all pad, then server-confirmed selection and reticle.

states.name: vertical_aim_up
states.note: Upward aim is confirmed in the authoritative snapshot before capture.

states.name: vertical_aim_down
states.note: Downward aim follows the same action, camera, and server pitch contract.

states.name: scatter_pellets
states.note: Single acknowledged shotgun blast into the floor about five units ahead. Seven pellets should land as seven separate impacts inside a tight cone.

states.name: rail_viewmodel
states.note: The Railgun taken from its pad on the north gantry, then server-confirmed selection and its distinct reticle.

states.name: rail_impact
states.note: Single acknowledged local rail shot into the gantry deck, sampled through expiry. Inspect the full-size shot and timed strip for position, sparks, trace, and decay.

states.name: return_to_spectator
states.note: Leave the match and follow a remaining fighter without stale geometry or hidden bodies.

states.name: spectator_chase
states.note: Return to chase after eye view. The watched body must be visible again.

states.name: profile_menu
states.note: Callsign, reticle colour, bob, save, and cancel. This capture does not overwrite the user's settings.

states.name: settings_menu
states.note: Settings share the pixel menu theme and remain fully legible.

states.name: settings_display
states.note: Explicit resolution, vertical FOV, window mode, frame cap, and VSync.

states.name: settings_graphics
states.note: Quality and supported upscaling choices, clear renderer fallback, pixel menu styling.

states.name: settings_audio
states.note: Separate master, radio, and effects controls with Save and Cancel.

states.name: settings_accessibility
states.note: Shared reduced-motion preference with cosmetic scope, Save and Cancel.

states.name: settings_controls
states.note: Controls page: every action with two keyboard or mouse slots and a gamepad slot, keyboard focus, reset.

states.name: settings_controls_pad
states.note: Controls page after a left trigger pull through the real input path. No pad is attached, so the letter layout is forced and recorded as such.

states.name: settings_look
states.note: Mouse sensitivity with cm per turn, key turn speed, stick shape and speeds, aim assist.

states.name: multiplayer_menu
states.note: Multiplayer asks one question first: Find / join a match, or Run a match.

states.name: multiplayer_join
states.note: Join view: direct address, the selected server's card with Watch and Join, then nearby and saved lists, without clipping.

states.name: single_player_menu
states.note: Recall Notice starts a local mission; arcade practice requires an existing server.

states.name: campaign_difficulty
states.note: Three explicit tiers with honest pressure descriptions and keyboard focus.

states.name: match_menu
states.note: Pixel match overlay keeps the live server visible and does not pretend to pause it.

states.name: match_settings
states.note: The same settings panel over a live match, with camera input blocked.

states.name: service_record
states.note: Persisted participant observations from this tour, with incomplete sessions labelled and exact attack denominators.
